title: Equivalent spring constant of combinations of springs
body: How the equivalent spring constant depends on the arrangement.

items.label: Springs in series
items.meaning: the equivalent spring constant is the sum of the individual spring constants

items.label: Springs in parallel
items.meaning: the equivalent spring constant is smaller than the smallest constituent spring constant

control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (2.6.C.3: a system appears weightless when no forces are exerted on it or when gravity is the only force exerted on it). The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: When a system appears weightless
body: A system appears weightless when there are no forces exerted on it, or when the force of gravity is the only force exerted on it.

expands_to.means: apparent weightlessness happens only when no gravitational force acts on the system

hooks.caution: State the condition in CED terms when answering.
